title: Create: Remedy
description: A small pack to improve the standard tool models and textures in Create (em' sowy, but for now only goggles)   ''- > -
body:
Now this pack only changes the goggles, making them more consistent with [brass](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/create_remedy/version/0.4)/[gold](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/create_remedy/version/vliu1yBO) (according to your preference) and so has a separate model for the view on the player.
There are plans to change all the tools from Create in the future, but for now I'm too busy, so will settle for just goggles.

[**simibubi**](https://modrinth.com/user/simibubi), I'm sorry if I offended you, it's just that the goggles you made are really poor. \
armor stand head texture i take from [this pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fancy-armor-stand-texture-pack)
